<div class="card-body">
'''LIN-V8M (Elleyein-Veeateemm)''' is a [[Dark]] [[Character]] ([[Droid]]) from [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)|The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">LIN-V8M（エライン・ヴィーエイテム）</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">地雷を敷設できる。また、ターン中の好きな時に、１フォース消費して同じ位置カードにある地雷を１つ“無効化”（ロスト）させられる。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ESB-Two-Player-LIN-V8M-Elleyein-Veeateemm-SWCA-100701.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">地雷の敷設を専門とする、軍用の装甲ドロイド。元来は鉱脈やスパイス鉱山に爆薬を仕掛けるためのものだが、軍用に改造されている。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' LIN-V8M (Elleyein-Veeateemm).

'''Card text:'''
May lay mines. Also, at any time during a turn, may use 1 Force to “defuse” (lose) one mine at the same location card.

'''Lore:'''
An armored military droid that specializes in laying mines. It was originally meant to plant explosives in ore veins and spice mines, but has been converted for military use.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Printed title is エライン・ヴィーエイテム; the Premiere black-border article reads エンライン・ヴィーエイテム.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[LIN-V8M (Elleyein-Veeateemm)]] in [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 45, 106. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
